contract:
Contract CoCoMESystem::openCashDesk(cashDeskID: Integer): Boolean {
	precondition:
		self.CurrentStore.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		self.CurrentStore.IsOpened = true and
		CashDesk.allInstances()->exists(c: CashDesk|c.Id = cashDeskID and
		c.IsOpened = false)
	postcondition:
		result = true and
		self.CurrentCashDesk = CashDesk.allInstances()->any(c: CashDesk|c.Id = cashDeskID) and
		self.CurrentCashDesk.IsOpened = true
}
